# Decalove

> An AI-directed visual novel: the story is written for you as you play, with persistent characters, relationships and memories.

## Endpoints
- Homepage: https://decalove.nevatal.id/
- API: https://decalove.nevatal.id/api/
- API Catalog: https://decalove.nevatal.id/.well-known/api-catalog
- Agent Card: https://decalove.nevatal.id/.well-known/agent-card.json
- AI Catalog: https://decalove.nevatal.id/.well-known/ai-catalog.json
- Authentication Guide: https://decalove.nevatal.id/auth.md
